banner:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished GitHub repository release banner, landscape 2:1 composition, preferably 1536x768 pixels.
Primary request: a premium contemporary release banner for the open-source software project DEVELOPER HARNESS, a model-neutral local development workflow layer. Make it visually memorable and exquisitely typeset, with excellent contrast and professional editorial spacing, not a busy AI infographic.
Visual direction: matte near-black graphite background with very subtle blueprint grid. On the right an elegant architectural sculptural core made of four interlocking precision-machined black-metal frames with restrained warm ivory edge lighting and a small luminous cyan seam. A metaphor for a strong engineered foundation, abstract and original. Large quiet negative space for typography on left, no fake app screenshot, no robots, no brand logos.
Text verbatim, accurately spelled:
Top small eyebrow: "OPEN SOURCE · v1.0.0"
Main large heading on two lines: "DEVELOPER" / "HARNESS"
Subheading: "Build with intent. Ship with evidence."
Small bottom line: "Your AI. Your tools. Your workflow."
Typography: bold modern grotesk heading, refined clean sans serif for the rest, warm ivory text and cyan accents. Keep all text at least 7% inset from edges, high readability at thumbnail size. Sophisticated, calm, powerful, premium.
Do not include any other product/project names, any author name, performance numbers, unproven claims, URLs, watermark, charts, precise diagrams, or invented badges. This is final artwork for a repository and a release.
